description: This file is a code-behind for the UserProfile ASPX page in an online examination system, handling user profile display, session validation, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Partial class representing the user profile page logic, including loading user data and navigation controls.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves user info from database if session exists, otherwise redirects to login.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event to navigate to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle profile button click, but currently commented out.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event to navigate to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: NameTB_TextChanged
methods.description: Placeholder for event when the user changes their name text box; currently does nothing.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles logout button click; redirects to login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event to navigate to the taken courses page.
